pages.text: Engravable gems can be crafted from all most any vanilla gem or crystal. Diamond, redstone, lapis, emerald, quartz, amethyst shards, prismarine shards, glowstone dust, copper and ender pearls all work.$(br2)Each material accepts only certain patterns — see $(l:socket-sorcery:gems/compatibility)Compatibility$(/l).
Every engravable gem can be crafted in the same shape.
